sentences.en: For seven decades, Georgia O’Keeffe (1887–1986) was a major figure in American art.
sentences.zh: 乔治娅·欧姬芙（1887—1986）在长达七十年的时间里一直是美国艺术界的重要人物。

sentences.en: Remarkably, she remained independent from shifting art trends and her work stayed true to her own vision, which was based on finding the essential, abstract forms in nature.
sentences.zh: 难能可贵的是，她始终独立于不断变化的艺术潮流，作品也始终忠于自己的艺术理念，也就是在自然中找寻本质的、抽象的形式。

sentences.en: With exceptionally keen powers of observation and great finesse with a paintbrush, she recorded subtle nuances of colour, shape, and light that enlivened her paintings and attracted a wide audience.
sentences.zh: 凭借非凡敏锐的观察力和精湛的用笔技巧，她捕捉到色彩、形态和光线的细微变化，使画作生动鲜活，吸引了众多观众。

sentences.en: Born in 1887 near Sun Prairie, Wisconsin to cattle breeders Francis and Ida O’Keeffe, Georgia was raised on their farm along with her six siblings.
sentences.zh: 1887年，乔治娅出生在威斯康星州森普雷里附近，父母弗朗西斯和艾达·欧姬芙以养牛为业。她和六个兄弟姐妹在自家的农场长大。

sentences.en: By the time she graduated from high school in 1905, she had determined to make her way as an artist.
sentences.zh: 到1905年高中毕业时，她已经决心走上艺术家之路。

sentences.en: She studied the techniques of traditional painting at the Art Institute of Chicago school (1905) and the Art Students League of New York (1907–8).
sentences.zh: 她在芝加哥艺术学院（1905年）和纽约艺术学生联盟（1907至1908年）学习了传统绘画技法。

sentences.en: After attending university and then training college, she became an art teacher and taught in elementary schools, high schools, and colleges in Virginia, Texas, and South Carolina from 1911 to 1918.
sentences.zh: 先上大学、再读师范院校之后，她成为一名美术教师，并于1911年至1918年间在弗吉尼亚州、得克萨斯州和南卡罗来纳州的小学、中学和学院任教。

sentences.en: During this period, O’Keeffe began to experiment with creating abstract compositions in charcoal, and produced a series of innovative drawings that led her art in a new direction.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，欧姬芙开始尝试用木炭创作抽象构图，画出了一系列富有新意的素描，带领她的艺术创作走向新的方向。

sentences.en: She sent some of these drawings to a friend in New York, who showed them to art collector and photographer Alfred Stieglitz in January 1916.
sentences.zh: 她把其中一些素描寄给纽约的一位朋友。1916年1月，这位朋友拿给艺术收藏家兼摄影师阿尔弗雷德·斯蒂格利茨看。

sentences.en: Stieglitz was impressed, and exhibited the drawings later that year at his gallery on Fifth Avenue, New York City, where the works of many avant-garde artists and photographers were introduced to the American public.
sentences.zh: 这些画给斯蒂格利茨留下了深刻印象，当年晚些时候，他就在纽约市第五大道自己的画廊展出了它们；许多先锋派艺术家和摄影师的作品正是通过这家画廊被介绍给美国公众的。

sentences.en: With Stieglitz’s encouragement and promise of financial support, O’Keeffe arrived in New York in June 1918 to begin a career as an artist.
sentences.zh: 有了斯蒂格利茨的鼓励和经济资助的承诺，欧姬芙于1918年6月来到纽约，开始了自己的艺术家生涯。

sentences.en: For the next three decades, Stieglitz vigorously promoted her work in twenty-two solo exhibitions and numerous group installations.
sentences.zh: 随后的三十年中，斯蒂格利茨通过22次个展和许多群展，大力推介她的作品。

sentences.en: The two were married in 1924.
sentences.zh: 两人于1924年结婚。

sentences.en: The ups and downs of their personal and professional relationship were recorded in Stieglitz’s celebrated black-and-white portraits of O’Keeffe, taken over the course of twenty years (1917–37).
sentences.zh: 斯蒂格利茨在二十年间（1917至1937年）为欧姬芙拍摄了著名的黑白肖像组照，记录下两人在私人生活与职业关系中的起起伏伏。

sentences.en: By the mid-1920s, O’Keeffe was recognized as one of America’s most important and successful artists, widely known for the architectural pictures that dramatically depict the soaring skyscrapers of New York.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪20年代中期，欧姬芙已被公认为美国最重要、最成功的艺术家之一，以气势十足地描绘纽约高耸摩天大楼的建筑画而广为人知。

sentences.en: But most often, she painted botanical subjects, inspired by annual trips to the Stieglitz family summer home.
sentences.zh: 不过，她最常画的是植物题材，灵感来自她每年去斯蒂格利茨家族避暑别墅的旅行。

sentences.en: In her magnified images depicting flowers, begun in 1924, O’Keeffe brings the viewer right into the picture.
sentences.zh: 在始于1924年的花卉放大画中，欧姬芙把观者直接带入了画面。

sentences.en: Enlarging the tiniest details to fill an entire metre-wide canvas emphasized their shapes and lines and made them appear abstract.
sentences.zh: 她把最微小的细节放大，直至占满整幅一米宽的画布，这突出了它们的形状和线条，使它们显得抽象。

sentences.en: Such daring compositions helped establish O’Keeffe’s reputation as an innovative modernist.
sentences.zh: 这些大胆的构图帮助欧姬芙确立了富于创新的现代主义艺术家的声誉。

sentences.en: In 1929, O’Keeffe made her first extended trip to the state of New Mexico.
sentences.zh: 1929年，欧姬芙首次前往新墨西哥州作较长时间的旅行。

sentences.en: It was a visit that had a lasting impact on her life, and an immediate effect on her work.
sentences.zh: 这次造访对她的生活产生了持久的影响，也立即影响到了她的创作。

sentences.en: Over the next two decades she made almost annual trips to New Mexico, staying up to six months there, painting in relative solitude, then returning to New York each winter to exhibit the new work at Stieglitz’s gallery.
sentences.zh: 随后的二十年里，她几乎每年都去新墨西哥州，每次在那里待上最长六个月，在较为清静的环境中独自作画，每年冬天再回到纽约，在斯蒂格利茨的画廊展出新作。

sentences.en: This pattern continued until she moved permanently to New Mexico in 1949.
sentences.zh: 这种生活模式一直延续到1949年，那年她在新墨西哥州定居下来。

sentences.en: There, O’Keeffe found new inspiration: at first, it was the numerous sun-bleached bones she came across in the state’s rugged terrain that sparked her imagination.
sentences.zh: 欧姬芙在那里找到了新的灵感。最初激发她想象力的，是她在当地崎岖地形中偶然见到的许多被太阳晒白的骨头。

sentences.en: Two of her earliest and most celebrated Southwestern paintings exquisitely reproduce a cow skull’s weathered surfaces, jagged edges, and irregular openings.
sentences.zh: 她描绘美国西南地区的画作中，有两幅不仅属于最早的一批作品，也是其中最著名的。它们细腻地再现了一个牛头骨饱经风化的表面、参差不齐的边缘和不规则的孔洞。

sentences.en: Later, she also explored another variation on this theme in her large series of Pelvis pictures, which focused on the contrasts between convex and concave surfaces, and solid and open spaces.
sentences.zh: 后来，她在规模庞大的“骨盆”系列画作中探索了这个主题的另一种变体，着重表现凸面与凹面、实体与空处之间的对比。

sentences.en: However, it was the region’s spectacular landscape, with its unusual geological formations, vivid colours, clarity of light, and exotic vegetation, that held the artist’s imagination for more than four decades.
sentences.zh: 然而，四十多年来一直吸引着这位艺术家想象力的，是当地壮丽的风景：奇特的地质构造、鲜明的色彩、澄澈的光线，以及充满异域风情的植被。

sentences.en: Often, she painted the rocks, cliffs, and mountains in striking close-up, just as she had done with her botanical subjects.
sentences.zh: 她经常用引人注目的特写画岩石、峭壁和群山，就像画植物题材时那样。

sentences.en: O’Keeffe eventually owned two homes in New Mexico – the first, her summer retreat at Ghost Ranch, was nestled beneath 200-metre cliffs, while the second, used as her winter residence, was in the small town of Abiquiú.
sentences.zh: 欧姬芙最终在新墨西哥州有了两处住所。第一处是她在幽灵牧场的避暑住处，坐落在200米高的峭壁脚下；另一处冬季住所位于阿比基乌小镇。

sentences.en: While both locales provided a wealth of imagery for her paintings, one feature of the Abiquiú house – the large walled patio with its black door – was particularly inspirational.
sentences.zh: 这两处地方都为她的绘画提供了丰富的意象。阿比基乌住宅的一处特色尤其能激发她的灵感，那就是一座带有黑色大门、四周围着墙的宽敞庭院。

sentences.en: In more than thirty pictures between 1946 and 1960, she reinvented the patio into an abstract arrangement of geometric shapes.
sentences.zh: 在1946年至1960年间的三十多幅画中，她把这座庭院重新构想成由几何形状组成的抽象构图。

sentences.en: From the 1950s into the 1970s, O’Keeffe travelled widely, making trips to Asia, the Middle East, and Europe.
sentences.zh: 从20世纪50年代一直到70年代，欧姬芙游历了许多地方，去过亚洲、中东和欧洲。

sentences.en: Flying in planes inspired her last two major series – aerial views of rivers and expansive paintings of the sky viewed from just above clouds.
sentences.zh: 乘飞机旅行启发了她最后两个重要的系列：从空中俯瞰河流的作品，以及从刚高出云层处望向天空的大幅画作。

sentences.en: In both series, O’Keeffe increased the size of her canvases, sometimes to mural proportions, reflecting perhaps her newly expanded view of the world.
sentences.zh: 在这两个系列中，欧姬芙增大了画布尺寸，有时大到堪比壁画，这或许反映了她看待世界的视野又开阔了。

sentences.en: When in 1965 she successfully translated one of her cloud motifs to a monumental canvas measuring 6 metres in length (with the help of assistants), it was an enormous challenge and a special feat for an artist nearing eighty years of age.
sentences.zh: 1965年，在助手协助下，她成功地把一幅云景的主题移到一张长六米的巨幅画布上。对一位年近八十的艺术家来说，这是一次极大的挑战，也是一次非凡的成就。

sentences.en: The last two decades of the artist’s life were relatively unproductive as ill health and blindness hindered her ability to work.
sentences.zh: 这位艺术家人生的最后二十年作品相对较少，因为疾病和失明妨碍了她的创作。

sentences.en: O’Keeffe died in 1986 at the age of ninety-eight, but her rich legacy of some 900 paintings has continued to attract subsequent generations of artists and art lovers who derive inspiration from these very American images.
sentences.zh: 欧姬芙1986年去世，享年98岁。她留下了约900幅画作，这份丰厚的艺术遗产始终吸引着后世的艺术家和艺术爱好者，他们从这些极具美国特色的画面中汲取灵感。
